- Build a complete, playable low-poly 3D zombie-apocalypse game for phones/tablets, featuring guns, an open-world feel, and a couple’s story.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone/tablet play with usable touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML Canvas game with a low-poly city, Mara and Eli, pursuing zombies, four weapons, and a radio-tower objective.
- Added desktop keyboard/mouse controls and mobile joystick/action buttons.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game in `index.html` with title/story screen, HUD, movement, weapon switching, shooting/reloading, zombie AI/combat, and ending screen.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright, captured and inspected `screenshots/last-light.jpg` and `screenshots/last-light-play.jpg`.

content.text:
Built **LAST LIGHT: Two Against the End** in `index.html`—a playable low-poly, 3D-style zombie-survival game about Mara and Eli crossing the city to reach a radio tower.

It includes four weapons, ammo and reloading, pursuing zombies, a health bar, and an ending. Desktop controls use WASD/arrows, mouse, R, and 1–4; phone and tablet controls use the on-screen joystick and action buttons.

I checked the game in-browser and saved screenshots at `screenshots/last-light.jpg` and `screenshots/last-light-play.jpg`. The only console error was a missing favicon; it didn’t affect gameplay.
